Body.Content:
Extends Billing Hub with clearer visibility into transactions that are not ready for invoicing and additional billing views. Billing users gain a more complete picture of the backlog and can manage invoice preparation with fewer manual steps, helping them distinguish work that can be billed from items that still need attention.

GA date: February CY2027
